question: Will Israel withdraw behind the original Yellow Line in Gaza before January 1, 2027?

calls.reasoning: Base rate: Israel voluntarily pulling back from a ceasefire control line it holds in Gaza or Lebanon, within about a quarter and with no handover trigger like a foreign stabilization force deploying, is rare (roughly 5% per quarter). Current evidence runs the other way: as of 14-16 Oct 2026 the Yellow Line is still advancing (10-100 m at a time), Palestinians hold under 40% of Gaza against 47% under the original line, and in Aug 2026 the Board of Peace made full Hamas disarmament a precondition for any withdrawal. Only about 2.5 months remain. Upside tail: a sudden US-brokered phase-two deal, or a local pullback in one sector tied to a foreign-force deployment, which might count under 'any distance behind'. Web search and fetch failed this run (API errors), and the market check on Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi and bookmakers could not run; the harness title search found no Polymarket or Manifold market. Evidence comes only from the question background and the two supplied news items, so I stay near a low base rate.

calls.dossier:
- Middle East Eye, 2026-10-16: personal account from a MAP worker saying the Yellow Line has moved daily, with Israeli forces advancing 10-100 m at a time; Kamal Adwan Hospital sits 150 m from the line and suspended services in Sept 2026; Indonesian Hospital was converted into an IDF base (June 2025).
- Al-Quds Al-Arabi, 2026-10-14: Israeli forces still expanding the Yellow Line into eastern Gaza City; artillery and gunfire in Tuffah and Shuja'iyya (behind the line); fire from military vehicles near the line at Deraj and Al-Sahaba.
- Al Jazeera, 2026-08-04 (per question background): the US-led Board of Peace said no Israeli withdrawal from the Yellow Line before Hamas fully disarms.
- UN News, mid-Sept 2026 (per background): Palestinians live in less than 40% of Gaza's land, against 47% under the original line (which gave Israel 53%).
- LA Times, 2026-08-09 (per background): the Yellow Line is increasingly encroaching further into Gaza.
- Haaretz, 2026-09-03 (per background): IDF troops killing people on or near the line.
- Status quo: IDF holds more than the original 53% and the line is moving westward, not eastward; no announced withdrawal found in the supplied material.
- Resolution instrument: resolves on credible reports of BOTH an announced Israeli withdrawal to behind the ORIGINAL October 2025 Yellow Line (OCHA map) AND a physical withdrawal giving up military control of the vacated area, held for at least 24 hours. Any distance behind the original line counts; the Orange Lines are irrelevant. It does not resolve on pulling back only to the current, expanded line.
- Event window: question open (2026-10-12) -> before 2027-01-01 per the criteria; as of 2026-10-16 about 5% of the 81-day window has elapsed (about 76 days remain).
- Base rate (constructed, not published): voluntary IDF pullbacks from ceasefire control lines in Gaza or Lebanon over a quarter-length window, given no foreign-force handover underway, are rare; historically, partial pullbacks (e.g. Lebanon 2025) were tied to a negotiated deployment of other forces, and even then Israel kept some positions.
- Possible YES paths: a US-brokered phase-two breakthrough; deployment of an international stabilization force with an IDF redeployment in a sector; a localized pullback that might count under 'any distance'.
- Searched for but could not retrieve (tool failures this run): recent news on phase-two negotiations, ISF deployment status, Hamas disarmament talks, Israeli election-cycle politics, and any Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi or bookmaker market on this event.
